mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a suggested answer or tentative solution to a problem."
A hypothesis is a suggested answer or tentative solution to a problem.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statistical test for detecting differences in group means when there is one parametric dependent variable and one or more independent (categorical) variables."
ANOVA is a statistical test for detecting differences in group means when there is one parametric dependent variable and one or more independent (categorical) variables.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a predictive statement, capable of being tested by scientific methods, that relates an independent variable to some dependent variable."
Quite often a research hypothesis is a predictive statement, capable of being tested by scientific methods, that relates an independent variable to some dependent variable.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the determination of the correction term (CT)."
Rather an important estimation is the determination of the correction term (CT).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the application of statistical methods to the study of economic data and problems."
Econometrics is the application of statistical methods to the study of economic data and problems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mixed bag, for β1 is linear but not ln β0."
Model d is a mixed bag, for β1 is linear but not ln β0.
fib: ______ is used to test for the significance of the rank correlation coefficient, r', provided that the sample size is large.
The Z-statistic is used to test for the significance of the rank correlation coefficient, r', provided that the sample size is large.
______ is an essential component of most other econometrics techniques.
OLS is an essential component of most other econometrics techniques.
______ is a measure of the degree of relationship existing between two variables.
Correlation is a measure of the degree of relationship existing between two variables.
______ is the best line that could be drawn to fit into the scatter diagram.
Regression line is the best line that could be drawn to fit into the scatter diagram.
______ is a statistical tool used to detect differences between experimental group means.
Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) is a statistical tool used to detect differences between experimental group means.
